services.desc: The Kingsland Homestead closes officially by 8pm. All guests/visitors to the house must depart by 9pm. Built between 1774 and 1785, the Kingsland Homestead provides the perfect backdrop for your photographs and memories. The Kingsland Homestead provides a perfect atmosphere for intimate gatherings all year round. A neighbor to Weeping Beech Park, the Kingsland Homestead has lush surroundings with great color throughout the year, adding to vivacious color to any event. The Kingsland Homestead has various opportunities for events with multiple rooms available. A beautiful antique staircase links the first and second floor for intimate events that require more room. blurb: Built between 1774 and 1785, the Kingsland Homestead is one of the earliest surviving examples of residential style construction common throughout Long Island, specifically Queens, in the late 18th and 19th centuries. A Long Island half-house, it is characterized by a wide side hall and double parlors off to one side.
